name: @pipeworx/mcp-lob

tools.name: lob_verify_address
tools.description: Verify a single US address for deliverability and return USPS-standardized/corrected components (ZIP+4, DPV codes, county, lat/lon). Pass structured components (primary_line, city, state, zip_code) OR a single freeform `address` string — not both. Example: lob_verify_address({ primary_line: "185 Berry St", secondary_line: "Ste 6100", city: "San Francisco", state: "CA", zip_code: "94107", _apiKey: "your-key" }) or lob_verify_address({ address: "185 Berry St Ste 6100 San Francisco CA 94107", _apiKey: "your-key" })

address.description: Full single-line address, e.g. "185 Berry St San Francisco CA 94107". Use this OR the component fields, not both.

primary_line.description: Primary street address line, e.g. "185 Berry St".

_apiKey.description: Your Lob API key (sign up at https://dashboard.lob.com/).

tools.name: lob_verify_bulk
tools.description: Verify a list of US addresses in one request. Each address is an object with primary_line, city, state, zip_code (secondary_line/recipient optional). Returns per-address deliverability + corrected components. Example: lob_verify_bulk({ addresses: [{ primary_line: "210 King St", city: "San Francisco", state: "CA", zip_code: "94107" }], _apiKey: "your-key" })

addresses.description: Array of address objects, each with primary_line, city, state, zip_code (secondary_line, recipient, urbanization optional).

_apiKey.description: Your Lob API key (sign up at https://dashboard.lob.com/).

tools.name: lob_autocomplete
tools.description: Autocomplete a partial US address. Given a primary-line prefix (and optional city/state/zip), returns up to 10 full address suggestions. Suggestions are candidates, not guaranteed deliverable — verify with lob_verify_address. Example: lob_autocomplete({ address_prefix: "185 B", city: "San Francisco", state: "CA", _apiKey: "your-key" })

address_prefix.description: Partial primary line to complete, e.g. "185 B".

_apiKey.description: Your Lob API key (sign up at https://dashboard.lob.com/).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-lob forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the lob pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
